caption: A tablecloth is pulled sharply out from under a set of plates and glasses, and the dishes stay almost where they were on the bare table.

sa.check: Plates and glasses stand on a tablecloth.
The cloth is pulled sharply out from under them.
The dishes stay almost where they were on the bare table.
The pull comes first and the dishes settle after.

pc.expect: The cloth leaves in one quick motion while the dishes shift only slightly and settle.
pc.fail: The dishes fly off with the cloth; or rise; or slide far across the table.

pc.expect: All the dishes remain on the table with the same count.
pc.fail: A dish vanishes; or appears; or a dish is found under the cloth.

pc.expect: The dishes do not move before the pull.
pc.fail: They move before; or move after settling; or jump.

pc.expect: The cloth flows out flat and the dishes are rigid.
pc.fail: The cloth is rigid; or the dishes bend; or the cloth tears.

pc.expect: The dishes keep their shape and the table stays one table.
pc.fail: A dish turns into another object; or the table duplicates; or dishes merge.

pc.expect: The dishes and the room stay the same.
pc.fail: The dishes change pattern; or the table changes; or the room rearranges.

note: The hands pulling are kept as the minimal trigger; the person is not judged.
